queue.title: The Reference Check Is Broken
queue.description: The standard reference call has become theater — a scripted exchange nobody learns anything from. Here is what I ask instead, and why it works.

queue.title: The First Ninety Days Are a Promise
queue.description: Most onboarding treats the first three months as paperwork and patience. I treat them as the most honest promise a company ever makes to a new hire.

queue.title: The Headcount Trap
queue.description: When something is not working, the reflex is to add people. More often than not, headcount buries the problem instead of solving it.

queue.title: The Second Sip Problem
queue.description: A functional drink can win the first sip on novelty. The second sip is where the real business is won or lost — and most brands never think about it.

queue.title: The Reorder Is Everything
queue.description: Getting onto the shelf feels like the win. In beverage, the shelf is rented, and the only rent that counts is velocity. The reorder is the whole game.
